title: Area 51 barely discussed before Lazar

tellings.quote: Area 51 was >> barely probably not ever really talked about before Bob Lazar.

plain: Area 51, a secret US test site in the Nevada desert, was hardly ever talked about in public before a man named Bob Lazar came forward in 1989. That is how Michels puts it himself, without naming a source, while discussing how the Pentagon handles UFO matters. To him it marks Lazar as the person who first made the base a public name.
